cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Helpful Culprit
cards.instruction: Hide that the problem is your fault while enthusiastically helping investigate it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The office plant's dead. I taught you to investigate before blaming anyone; I'll help you work through it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You watered it with your coffee.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent memory. Now move beyond observation, as we practised. I'll test whether the machine makes plant-safe coffee.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You added six sugars. The machine didn't do that.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you've isolated a variable. I'll make six comparison cups. You label them; your handwriting has improved since I made you redo the files.
